name: OAuthAuthCode
description: Plan-32 C — single-use OAuth authorization code. Created at /consent (approve), exchanged at /token for an access token + refresh token. Auto-expires after 60 seconds via expiresAt (query-time filter). Single-use enforced by usedAt — the second exchange attempt returns invalid_grant and revokes any tokens issued from the same code (OAuth best practice §10.4). Lives in schema0 only (platformOnly).

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Random 64-char auth code. Stored plaintext because (a) lifetime is 60s, (b) single-use enforced, (c) lookup-by-equality on every /token call. Refresh tokens use SHA256 hashes — their lifetime is 30d, so the cost/benefit flips.

attributes.name: clientId
attributes.description: OAuth client that requested the code. Must match the client_id sent to /token.

attributes.name: redirectUri
attributes.description: Must match the redirect_uri sent to /token (exact-match).

attributes.name: codeChallenge
attributes.description: PKCE code_challenge captured at /authorize. /token validates SHA256(code_verifier) == codeChallenge.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: OAuth scopes granted at consent. Echoed back in the token response.

attributes.name: userTenantId
attributes.description: Tenant the user selected and consented for. Baked into the issued JWT.

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: User who consented. Baked into the issued JWT.

attributes.name: expiresAt
attributes.description: Epoch ms. /consent sets this to now + 60 seconds.

attributes.name: usedAt
attributes.description: Epoch ms of the successful /token exchange. Null while unused. A second /token request seeing non-null here returns invalid_grant and revokes the refresh token chain that came from this code (OAuth 2.0 best practice §10.4).
